title: Frog wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Frog head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='10' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='34' r='10' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Eye whites -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='7' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='34' r='7' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='34' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q50 64 64 52' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='4' fill='#F48FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='4' fill='#F48FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='88' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='88' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Toes -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='90' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='93' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='90' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='90' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='93' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='90' r='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,30 62,30' fill='#FF5252'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,22 56,22' fill='#FFD740'/>
  <polygon points='44,22 38,30 50,30' fill='#FFD740'/>
  <polygon points='56,22 50,30 62,30' fill='#FFD740'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <line x1='42' y1='26' x2='58' y2='26' stroke='#FF5252' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#FFD740'/>
  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x='38' y='28' width='24' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E040FB'/>
</svg>
